description: Adds static blue noise after video colour processing and fade, on the background/base layer only; 8-bit or 10-bit input, always 8-bit sRGB output. Selectable per layer, but turn OLED's VD-like fovea options off when combining. Unknown host shaders pass through unchanged.
name: Background blue-noise dithering (experimental)

options.description: Both choices apply the same final 8-bit output quantizer. This describes your stream; it does not change host negotiation or decoder precision. When combining with OLED calibration, leave both of its existing VD-like fovea toggles off.
options.title: Declared input depth

description: Renames the package and Steam Link's internal VR-launch component, so the patched app can be installed next to the original.
name: Change package name

options.description: Accepts either a full Java package name (for example, com.valvesoftware.steamlinkvr.galaxyxr) or a display suffix (for example, Galaxy XR). Suffix input appends to app name and generates a package suffix automatically.
options.title: Package name

description: Adapts already corrected OpenXR angular velocity to Steam Link 2.0.23's local controller axes. Requires the active Galaxy XR OpenXR Velocity Frame runtime module; do not use with stock runtime velocities or old HAL/velocity/extrapolation APK layers. Changes angular velocity only, not poses, linear velocity or prediction. Exact 2.0.23/5002363 only; headset A/B validation pending.
name: Controller angular world to local, 2.0.23 (experimental)

description: Routes controller vibration to the grip vibrator instead of the trigger, which Galaxy XR uses for every OpenXR vibration. The grip one needs shell rights, so this needs Shizuku running with its permission granted to Steam Link; without it vibration is stock.
name: Controller grip haptics through Shizuku (experimental)

description: Makes the Galaxy XR runtime extrapolate controller poses to the time VRLink asks, instead of repeating one sample per display frame, and filters jitter out of the streamed pose. Adds an OpenXR API layer; no Steam Link code changes.
name: Controller pose extrapolation (experimental)

description: Takes controller poses straight from the Galaxy XR controller HAL instead of the OpenXR runtime, removing the runtime's ~35 ms sample lag, and filters jitter out of pose and velocity. The HAL needs shell rights, so this needs Shizuku running with its permission granted to Steam Link; without Shizuku tracking stays as it is. Steam Link 2.0.23: angular velocity is reported local to the grip pose.
name: Controller tracking from the controller HAL through Shizuku (experimental)

description: Takes controller poses straight from the Galaxy XR controller HAL instead of the OpenXR runtime, removing the runtime's ~35 ms sample lag, and filters jitter out of pose and velocity. The HAL needs shell rights, so this needs Shizuku running with its permission granted to Steam Link; without Shizuku tracking stays as it is. Steam Link 2.0.20 - 2.0.22: angular velocity is reported in the base space.
name: Controller tracking from the controller HAL through Shizuku, 2.0.20 - 2.0.22 (experimental)

description: Derives controller linear and angular velocity from grip/aim pose history, and can cut VRLink's 4 controller pose sends per display frame to 2 or 1.
name: Controller velocity fix

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+32 (int64 ns = value×1e6). Falls back to runtime velocity when pose samples are farther apart. Allowed range: 5 to 100 ms.
options.title: Maximum sample gap (ms)

options.description: libvrlink_scene.so QSVLClient::OnTopOfFrame: selects four, two, or one evenly phased controller pose sends per display frame. Actual send Hz equals display Hz multiplied by 4, 2, or 1. Stock preserves Valve behavior.
options.title: Controller pose-send cadence

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+48 (float32 EMA weight). 0 = no smoothing, minimum lag; higher values reduce jitter. Allowed range: 0.0 to 0.9.
options.title: Derived velocity smoothing

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+40 (float32 m/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived linear speed. Allowed range: 1 to 50 m/s.
options.title: Maximum linear speed (m/s)

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+44 (float32 rad/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived angular speed. Allowed range: 1 to 100 rad/s.
options.title: Maximum angular speed (rad/s)

description: Rotates the controller velocities the Galaxy XR runtime reports into the frames SteamVR reads, so thrown objects leave in the right direction. Stock, they arrive in a controller-attached frame. Adds an OpenXR API layer; no Steam Link code is changed. Steam Link 2.0.23: angular velocity is reported local to the streamed pose.
name: Controller velocity frame (experimental)

description: Rotates the controller velocities the Galaxy XR runtime reports into the frames SteamVR reads, so thrown objects leave in the right direction. Stock, they arrive in a controller-attached frame. Adds an OpenXR API layer; no Steam Link code is changed. Steam Link 2.0.20 - 2.0.22: angular velocity is reported in the base space.
name: Controller velocity frame, 2.0.20 - 2.0.22 (experimental)
